extracted.intended_audience: Investigators and research/admin staff preparing NIH grant applications (senior/key personnel, biographical sketches, and Research & Related budgets).
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and required fields for preparing the NIH-style Biographical Sketch for key personnel (including Personal Statement, Education/Training, Publications, Research Support) and the Research & Related Budget (Sections A–K) for grant applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Sketch — general format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH Provide the following information for the key personnel and other significant contributors in the order listed on Form Page 2. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified format and ordering for each person listed on Form Page 2; adhere to a strict four-page maximum for each biographical sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Name / eRA Commons user name / Position title
rubrics_metrics.description: Include NAME, eRA COMMONS USER NAME, and POSITION TITLE at the top of the biographical sketch.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present identifying details exactly as requested so reviewers and electronic systems can match personnel records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training table
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, and include postdoctoral training.) in a table with columns: INSTITUTION AND LOCATION, DEGREE (if applicable), YEAR(s), FIELD OF STUDY.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List institutions chronologically starting with the baccalaureate; include postdoctoral training. Use the table format shown to capture institution, degree, years, and field.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: A personal statement describing the individual's role on the application, how the proposed research aligns with their expertise, and what specific contributions/resources/effort they will provide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain qualifications and relevance to the proposed work (e.g., prior results, methodological expertise, collaborations, resources). Indicate level of effort and why the applicant was selected. Use examples to show alignment with the proposal's aims.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors (Positions and Employment / Professional Memberships / Awards)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Positions and Employment, Professional Memberships, and Honors/Awards chronologically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include dates and institution/organization for each position; list significant professional memberships and notable awards to demonstrate qualifications and standing.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Selected Peer‑reviewed Publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide selected peer-reviewed publications relevant to the application (explicitly include 'Five most relevant to the current application').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite five most relevant publications and may include additional publications (e.g., 'Additional publications within the last 3 years'). Use full citations to demonstrate track record and relevance.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Research Support (Ongoing and Recently Completed)
rubrics_metrics.description: List Research Support including Ongoing Research Support and Recently Completed Research Support with grant identifiers, PI names, dates, project title/major goals, and the individual's role (e.g., PI, Co-PI, Consultant).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each listed support provide funding number, PI, performance dates, major goal(s) of the project, and the applicant's specific Role. Distinguish ongoing vs recently completed support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical sketch — ordering and inclusion for each key person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the biographical sketch for each listed Senior/Key Person in the order listed on Form Page 2 following the provided headers (A–D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeat the full format for every key person; ensure consistency and that each section (Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Selected Publications, Research Support) is present where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section A: Senior/Key Person details
rubrics_metrics.description: Section A (Senior/Key Person) requires listing each senior/key person's name, project role, base salary, months (calendar/academic/summer), salary ($), benefits ($), and funds requested ($).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for all Senior/Key Persons. Include additional senior/key persons as needed. Show months of effort (calendar/academic/summer) and compute salary and benefits for funds requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Section B (Other Personnel) requires number of personnel by category (Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical), months of effort, salary ($), benefits ($), and funds requested ($) by project role.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List counts and effort for each category, provide salary and fringe calculations, and sum totals for Other Personnel. Include totals for A+B.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Subaward/Consortium entries
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide project/subaward/consortium line items where applicable (identify Project/Subaward/Consortium, include attachments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include subaward organization, budget period, and link attachments (view/delete/add). Indicate if a subaward entry should be deleted or added per the form controls.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: Section C requires listing equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000, with a total funds requested for equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each equipment item costing more than $5,000 with funds requested per item and sum to provide total equipment requested.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Section D (Travel) requires separate listing of Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs, with totals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Break out domestic and foreign travel line items and provide a total travel cost for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section E requires listing Participant/Trainee support costs: Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other, and the Number of Participants/Trainees.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide totals for participant/trainee support costs and specify the number of participants/trainees supported.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section F: Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section F (Other Direct Costs) includes categories such as Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List amounts requested for each other direct cost category and total them under Other Direct Costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section G: Direct Costs total
rubrics_metrics.description: Section G requires summing Total Direct Costs (A through F) to present the Direct Costs for the project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and present the total direct costs as the sum of Sections A–F for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section H: Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section H requires indicating Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and the Cognizant Federal Agency contact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the applicable indirect cost rate, base amount to which it applies, total indirect costs, and identify the cognizant federal agency and contact (name and phone).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Section I requires computing the Total Direct and Indirect Costs (Total Direct + Indirect Costs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Present the grand total for the budget period as the sum of Direct Costs (G) and Indirect Costs (H).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Section J is for Fee (if applicable) to be listed separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include any fee requested and present it as a distinct line item following the institutional total.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Budget — Section K: Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Section K (Budget Justification) requires narrative justification for requested costs and may include Indirect Cost Type and Funds Requested breakdowns. (Only attach one file.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a Budget Justification document explaining and justifying requested costs; indicate indirect cost type and funds requested per category. Attach only one budget justification file per instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form-level administrative fields (DUNS, Budget Type, Start/End Dates, Tracking/Funding info)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form includes administrative fields such as ORGANIZATIONAL DUNS, Budget Type, Start Date, End Date, Tracking Number, Funding Opportunity Number, Received Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete organizational identifiers (DUNS), budget period start/end dates, and include tracking/funding opportunity metadata as required by the form.
